title: myrtus rigida
intro: Myrtus rigida, commonly known as the rigid myrtle or Bois de chandelle, is a species of plant in the myrtle family. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used in herbal medicine. The health benefits of M. rigida include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations, prevent infections, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of M. rigida include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
